title: pilosella × bifurca subsp. breitenbrunnensis
intro: Pilosella × bifurca subsp. breitenbrunnensis, commonly known as a rare and unique subspecies of the Pilosella genus, is a hybrid plant that is native to specific regions in Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × bifurca subsp. breitenbrunnensis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its potential in preventing or treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for the plant's therapeutic actions include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and applications.
